messages:
maya: Quick question — my calendar shows the new-hire orientation at 9:00 AM (PDT) but the onboarding email lists 17:00 UTC. Which one should I trust? Also couldn't find last cohort's recording.

sam_peopleops: Hey Maya — trust the calendar event. We updated invites to UTC in the email body but the calendar should convert to your local TZ. If it's showing 9:00 AM for you then that's correct. Can you check which calendar the event is on? (Redwood Onboarding vs All Company) :slightly_smiling_face:

maya: It's on "Redwood Onboarding" calendar. Weird — the calendar event itself shows 9:00 but the invite preview shows 17:00 (and Outlook flagged it as possible duplicate).

olivia_hr: Thanks for flagging — we recently switched the template and some clients (Outlook desktop) still show the original UTC line in the body. We sent a follow-up to fix the email text but the event times are correct. If Outlook shows duplicates, try removing the extra invite from your mailbox and accept the one in your primary Redwood calendar.

jun_dev: FWIW, in previous cohorts the recording link was uploaded to Drive and posted in #new-hires. onboard-bot usually posts when it's ready.

onboard-bot: Recording uploaded for session 2026-03-19: https://drive.redwood.example/records/2026-03-19-orientation.mp4 (caption: "Orientation 03/19 — slides + Q&A")

maya: Thanks! That link works. Two followups: 1) Will there be a separate repeat for APAC people? 2) Is there a single handbook link we should read before the session?

sam_peopleops: 1) Yes — we run a second repeat at 02:00 UTC for APAC on Tuesdays (opt-in). You can RSVP on the calendar if you prefer that slot. 2) Handbook link: https://handbook.redwood.example/new-hire-onboarding — please skim the "Access & Accounts" and "Security training" sections before the session.

maya: Great. One more technical — I'm on a company-managed Mac and sometimes Calendar picks the wrong timezone when traveling. Any quick tip to force the event to show local TZ?

jun_dev: If you're comfortable in terminal you can check your system TZ: `date` and `systemsetup -gettimezone` (macOS). Also check in Calendar app > Preferences > Advanced > Turn off "Turn on time zone support" so events display in floating local time (or on if you want explicit TZ labels).

olivia_hr: If anything still looks off, DM me and I'll re-send the invite from people-ops. We can also add an "orientation (repeat APAC)" event to reduce confusion.

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll accept the calendar invite and watch the recording beforehand. :thumbsup:

sam_peopleops: TL;DR: calendar event is source of truth; email body had legacy UTC line; recording is uploaded and pinned; APAC repeat exists.

onboard-bot: Note: If you need captioned recording (SRT), request via /onboarding request-caption with the recording URL.

maya: Filed a caption request — thanks!
